name: Knowledge scan
description: Three times a week (Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 06:00 Dubai) the Knowledge Researcher scans the web for every knowledge category and topic the CBO chose on Knowledge Watch, and files dated, sourced items. Its one step starts the scan; the plugin then runs the researcher once per category in the background, tries a failed category once more, and goes on to the next, so one error never stops the rest. Its progress and any failure are on the Knowledge Watch Settings tab. Nothing is sent. Needs a web search provider.

steps.name: Start the scan
steps.description: Starts the plugin's own scan of every category, one researcher turn each, in the background.
steps.instruction: Call `knowledge_watch_start_scan` once, and nothing else: do not search or file anything yourself in this step. Reply with one line saying what it answered: the categories it started, or why it did not start.
